dependency: Task 188 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 196 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Existing points remain search anchors only and every row stays NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Victoria Leeds
features.official_source_evidence: The official Victoria Leeds site identifies the destination as a Leeds shopping centre with shops, dining, centre maps, parking and visitor information.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. The tracked object is a multi-arcade shopping-centre complex, so exact centre or parcel boundaries must be established before geometry binding.

features.name: St David's Cardiff
features.official_source_evidence: The official St David's Cardiff site presents shop, eat, play and visit functions and states that the centre contains more than 150 brands.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. The shopping-centre complex contains many units and requires an authoritative centre boundary rather than an inferred point footprint.

features.name: One Blackfriars
features.official_source_evidence: Berkeley Group's official completed-development page identifies One Blackfriars as its Southwark development; authoritative project records describe the principal tower and associated buildings.
features.classification_finding: The principal tower contains apartments, but the full development also includes hotel, retail and smaller buildings. Apartment Building can apply only to the residential tower after the principal footprint is isolated.

features.name: Kingston Lacy
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Kingston Lacy as a historic house and estate in Dorset and provides the authoritative visitor-property identity.
features.classification_finding: The principal country house is standalone, but the tracked name includes a wider estate and current heritage visitor use. The main house must be separated from estate land and Detached Home requires a documented taxonomy decision.

features.name: The Range Distribution Centre Avonmouth
features.official_source_evidence: The Range's official careers site confirms that the company operates major fulfilment and warehouse distribution centres. Independent published evidence identifies the Avonmouth building as The Range's distribution centre.
features.classification_finding: Industrial Unit is supported for the single large warehouse, but the exact Avonmouth operator/building page and authoritative footprint remain pending; a generic corporate distribution-centre page alone is not sufficient for final binding.

features.name: Centrale Croydon
features.official_source_evidence: The named official centre domain is retained as the primary target, but it was not reliably readable during this research pass. Authoritative published records identify Centrale as a Croydon shopping centre.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is supported, but current official-domain readback and exact centre boundary evidence remain required before publication or geometry binding.
